Public harm is reasonably likely to occur if normal, non- emergency clearance procedures are followed. The approval of this data collection process is essential to ensure that the Review Choice Demonstration (RCD) for Home Health (HH) Services is expanded to California within the specified timeframe. A delay in the expansion means an extended time the public will be harmed through the continuation of significant fraud found in the traditional Medicare home health benefit in California through the waste of taxpayer money, a loss of funds from the Medicare Trust Funds that could have been used for truly needed care, paying for care that is never delivered, and beneficiaries potentially receiving non-medically necessary care. Under the PRA, federal agencies are required to publish notice in the Federal Register concerning each proposed ICR. This revised draft guidance revises and replaces the draft guidance entitled "Essential Drug Delivery Outputs Intended to Deliver Drugs and Biological Products" announced in the Federal Register on July 1, 2024 (89 FR 54470). In accordance with its mission of protecting, promoting, and advancing public health, this guidance addresses key aspects of drug delivery performance information for devices, and combination products that include device constituent parts, intended for delivery of a human drug, including a biological product (herein referred to as drug delivery devices). This guidance provides recommendations for development and organization of device drug-delivery performance information and data to improve the consistency of this information in applications and to facilitate transparency and predictability in development and regulatory review. articles.title: Rural Minnesota hospitals' operations are withering. They say 'profiteering' drugmakers, insurers are to blame
articles.summary: In a press conference this week, the heads of rural nonprofit hospitals called for immediate lawmaker intervention as financially fatal federal policy changes loom around the corner.

articles.title: Talkiatry takes therapy nationwide as it builds out behavioral health platform
articles.summary: Talkiatry is expanding virtual therapy services nationwide as part of a broader push to provide comprehensive behavioral health services across the acuity spectrum, from low to high.

articles.title: KFF: Employer family premiums up 5% to $28K in 2026
articles.summary: Employer family premiums grew yet again in 2026, increasing by 5% to $28,303 on average, according to a new report from KFF.

articles.title: Integris Health to join Kaiser Permanente's Risant Health
articles.summary: Pending approvals, Oklahoma's largest nonprofit health system will follow in the footsteps of Geisinger Health and Cone Health in seeking outside investment and tech-enabled value-based care know-how from the Kaiser subsidiary.

articles.title: Amazon, Google among self-funded employers joining CMS' prior auth pledge
articles.summary: The Trump administration revealed Wednesday that five of the country's largest employers have signed on to expand electronic prior authorization in self-funded plans.

articles.title: Doximity adds UpToDate to Ask in push to become doctors’ go-to AI platform
articles.summary: Doximity inked a partnership with Wolters Kluwer to embed UpToDate's evidence-based clinical content directly within Doximity Ask, the company’s AI clinical decision support tool.

articles.title: Elevance Health poised for Medicaid improvements in 2027
articles.summary: Elevance Health is boosting its outlook for the year as it beat Wall Street analysts' expectations for both profit and revenue in the third quarter.

articles.title: Baba nabs $40M series A, backed by FirstMark Capital and CVS Health Ventures, for AI-powered Medicare patient navigation
articles.summary: The AI company plans to use the funding to further its research, reach more health plans and accelerate value-based arrangements, executives say.

articles.title: CMS defers $1.2B in Medicaid funds from California, puts New York on notice after raid
articles.summary: The Trump administration is withholding additional funds from California as part of its war with certain states over Medicaid fraud.

articles.title: HHS national kidney care plan takes aim at prevention, dialysis and transplant access
articles.summary: The plan has three priorities: preventing kidney failure, improving dialysis care while expanding patient choice and reforming the transplant system.
